title: Circular singly linked list
summary: Keep a tail pointer for a ring. Append in constant time and visit each value once by stopping when traversal returns to the head.
triggers: the last node links back to the first
round-robin traversal with no null terminator
prompts: A turn manager adds a new player at the end of a seating circle.
Read one full lap of checkpoints from a circular route.
invariant: In a nonempty ring, tail.next is the head.
mantra: Splice after the tail, then advance the tail.
pitfalls: Compare node identity when detecting a full lap because values can repeat.

anchors.name: Insert into a Sorted Circular Linked List
anchors.trick: Returning to the starting node marks a complete lap.

complexity.time: O(1) append, O(n) for one lap

mutations.explanation: Equal values can occur before the traversal has completed a lap.
